content:
### I’d Really Appreciate Honest Feedback on My CLO-SET Store

Hi everyone,

I’ve been creating and selling CLO3D / Marvelous Designer files on CLO-SET for a while, and I’ve built up quite a large collection of products.

However, I feel that my sales are much lower than I expected considering the quality and amount of content I’m producing.

I’d really appreciate **honest and critical feedback** from experienced creators and buyers here.

I’d like to know:

  * Is there anything wrong or missing in the quality of my files?

  * Are my product thumbnails good enough?

  * Are my titles, tags, and descriptions effective?

  * Are my products actually useful/desirable for buyers?

  * Is my pricing reasonable?

  * Do you see any problem with the way I present my products?

  * If you were a buyer, what would stop you from purchasing my files?

  * Is there anything you would change in my store or product strategy?




I’m not looking for compliments — **I genuinely want to know what I’m doing wrong and what I should improve.**

I’ll share a few examples of my products below.

Any honest feedback would be greatly appreciated. Thank you!
content_description: This page seeks honest and constructive feedback from experienced creators and buyers to improve the quality, presentation, and sales of CLO3D/Marvelous Designer files in the CLO-SET store.

title: Problem with Glasses Registration
content:
Hi, I need your help.

I created these glasses, as you can see in the first image.

I registered them, but the lenses appear black in the render even though they use the same material. Does anyone know how I can fix this issue?![30c923ff47c64468ac7ca2a452948ebd](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/fe4036a6eb0f4e0c99177d53d2461142/images/30c923ff47c64468ac7ca2a452948ebdScreenshot%202026-08-09%20110609.jpg)![cfdeaf5f900d418a82ad28d97a716abf](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/fe4036a6eb0f4e0c99177d53d2461142/images/cfdeaf5f900d418a82ad28d97a716abfScreenshot%202026-08-09%20110428.jpg)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Thank you for following up and for your guidance. I’ll give it a try and let you know how it goes.

Comment 2: Hi, I just tested this on several pattern pieces and glasses, with various results. So it is not clear to me what is causing the issue. At first, I suspected the difference in Absorption for both examples, but I have also produced an opaque pattern piece with the standard settings, so now I am confused. The only thing I can detemrine so far is that it appears to be connected to the color, all my examples work on #FFFFFF, but also NOT all of the ones on #D3B673 turn out opaque. I will investigate further and get back to you! (Unless one of my colleagues here has another idea?)
Reply 1: So far, I've determined that in order to display colored glass properly, Thick Textured Surface has to be toggled on. However, this should not affect your glasses. Are the glasses transparent when the color is set to white/none? (#ffffff)
content_description: Seeking help to resolve a rendering issue where registered glasses lenses appear black despite using the correct material.

title: Shorcuts are not working
content:
Hi everyone. I'm having an issue with the shortcuts in MD 2026. My shortcuts are enabled, and the shortcuts guide shows the cmd+z should perform undo, but it doesn't work at all. also pressing z just deletes everything instead of editing pattern. how can I fix it (undo is not working at all, it shows that clicking edit)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: It sounds like your shortcut mapping may have changed or become corrupted. The fact that Z is deleting instead of switching to the Edit Pattern tool suggests the keyboard shortcuts aren't using the default layout.I'd try these steps: Go to Settings/Preferences - Keyboard Shortcuts and see if the shortcut profile has been modified. Reset the shortcuts to the default preset if that option is available. Make sure the MD window is in focus and that no text field is active when using Cmd + Z. If you're on macOS, also check System Settings - Keyboard - Shortcuts to ensure another app or system shortcut isn't overriding Cmd + Z. If the issue started after updating to MD 2026, try creating a new project or resetting your user preferences, as preference files can sometimes become corrupted during an update.If Cmd + Z still doesn't work, could you let us know: Are you using macOS or Windows? Which MD 2026 version/build are you on?Does Edit - Undo work when you click it manually, or is that not responding either?That information will help narrow down whether it's a shortcut configuration issue or a bug with the current build.
content_description: This page provides troubleshooting guidance for resolving shortcut key issues, specifically the non-functioning undo command, in MD 2026.
